The model of DESIGN.md § 2: a generic `module`, `layer` instances, generic dimensions and a `vulkan(0)` device. None of these is in the M0 subset. The parser names each construct it does not have with its own code instead of a generic syntax error, so the output says what is missing rather than what is wrong.

The output below was recorded by `modelspec-docs` running the `modelspec` command line on the model; `task docs-check` fails when a run prints anything else.

## The model

[`examples/tiny_mlp.mspec`](https://github.com/beyond10x/modelspec/blob/main/examples/tiny_mlp.mspec):

```modelspec title="examples/tiny_mlp.mspec"
module Linear<In: dim, Out: dim> {
    param weight: Tensor<f32, [In, Out]> = xavier_uniform();

    fn forward<B: dim>(x: Tensor<f32, [B, In]>)
        -> Tensor<f32, [B, Out]> {
        return matmul(x, weight);
    }
}

model TinyMLP<B: dim> {
    layer fc1: Linear<32, 64>;
    layer fc2: Linear<64, 1>;

    fn forward(x: Tensor<f32, [B, 32]>)
        -> Tensor<f32, [B, 1]> {
        let h = relu(fc1.forward(x));
        return fc2.forward(h);
    }
}

train TinyFit {
    model = TinyMLP<64>;
    input  x: Tensor<f32, [64, 32]>;
    target y: Tensor<f32, [64, 1]>;
    loss = mse(model.forward(x), y);
    optimizer = sgd(lr = 0.001);
    steps = 1000;
    seed = 42;
    device = vulkan(0);
}
```
